_comment: Claims about model differences, pinned to the documents that make them.
Mirrors scripts/counted-claims.json, with one difference that is the whole point:
counted-claims checks EQUALITY against a resolver, this checks a BOUND against
eval/noise-floor.json. A claim of 6 pp on a suite that resolves 39.5 pp is not a
finding, however carefully it was measured.
kind: bound      the captured number is a claimed difference in percentage points
and must be >= what the suite can resolve. Matching NOTHING is
stale — the pin has outlived the prose it guarded.
kind: forbidden  an ordering with no magnitude. Matching ANYTHING fails; matching
nothing is the satisfied state, not staleness. State the size or
do not state the claim: whether the instrument could have seen a
difference depends entirely on its size.
`kind` is required on every entry. One rule cannot mean both directions, and a
There is no `bound` entry yet because no tracked document states a model delta. Adding
one before the prose exists would fail immediately as stale, which is the rule working.

claims.reason: An ordering with no magnitude. There is nothing to bound, and the artifact stores no verdict to validate it against — measurements only, never verdicts.
